input.quote: (a) In the event the Company terminates this Agreement, the Company shall pay to HDI a termination payment, (the "Termination Payment") the amount of which shall be an amount equal to the aggregate Net Sales for the twelve (12) months preceding the Termination Date less $800,000, the balance of which shall be divided by two.
input.rationale: Section 4.2(a) imposes a liquidated termination payment payable by the Company (our party) on any Company termination, calculated as 50% of trailing twelve-month Net Sales above $800,000. Because fees under Section 3.1 are only 30% of Net Sales above $11,000/month, the formula can exceed a full year of fees and the value of the remaining term (the agreement is a one-year auto-renewing term terminable on 90 days' notice), and it is not disapplied where the Company terminates for HDI's default (only the narrow Section 1.6 launch-failure right is "without penalty"). That fails both the preferred position (no customer-payable liquidated damages) and the fallback (early-termination fee capped at three months' fees). Given HDI's site build-out investment is the existing bargain, we propose the fallback rather than deletion: cap the Termination Payment at three months' fees and disapply it where we terminate for HDI's breach. Section 4.2(b)/(c) (no payment if the formula is zero or negative; eight quarterly instalments) mitigate but do not cure the exposure.

proposal.summary: Cap the Company-payable Termination Payment at three months' fees and disapply it where the Company terminates for HDI's breach
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 4.2 makes us pay HDI a formula-based termination payment (half of trailing twelve-month Net Sales above $800,000) whenever we terminate, which can far exceed the fees payable for the remaining term and applies even if we exit for HDI's default. Our playbook does not accept liquidated amounts payable by the customer; as a fallback we can live with an early-termination fee capped at three months' fees, and it should not apply where we terminate for HDI's breach.

ops.oldText: the balance of which shall be divided by two.
ops.newText: the balance of which shall be divided by two; provided, that in no event shall the Termination Payment exceed the aggregate fees paid by the Company to HDI pursuant to Section 3.1 during the three (3) months immediately preceding the Termination Date, and no Termination Payment shall be due in the event the Company terminates this Agreement as a result of HDI's breach of this Agreement.
